selected_script.angle: Targeting the frustration of contaminating the entire paper towel roll with greasy hands while struggling with a sliding, lightweight stand and separate spray bottles.
selected_script.hook: Stop using two dirty hands and a sliding stand just to tear one paper towel.

timeline.0-3s: A hand covered in kitchen oil struggles to tear a sheet from a flimsy paper towel holder, making the stand slip and contaminating the whole roll.
timeline.3-6s: The Ultrean matte black stand is introduced; a hand easily tears a sheet one-handed using the tension arm, while the heavy base stays anchored.
timeline.6-10s: The hand presses the top One-Push Lock button on the matte black rod, pulling out the integrated spray bottle, briefly revealing its clear reservoir.
timeline.10-14s: Close-up of the spray bottle nozzle spraying a fine cleaning mist onto a greasy countertop spill.
timeline.14-18s: A clean paper towel wiping the counter spotless, leaving the sleek matte black stand standing perfectly in place.
timeline.18-20s: Short visual CTA text: Upgrade your kitchen cleanup setup today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a close-up of a kitchen counter where a hand covered in cooking grease struggles to tear a sheet from a cheap plastic holder, causing the holder to slide around and ruin the roll. 3-6s: The matte black Ultrean Paper Towel Stand is shown; a hand easily tears a single sheet one-handed using the angled tension arm, while the 2.65lb weighted base stays completely still. 6-10s: The user pushes the button on top of the black rod and pulls out the hidden spray bottle, showing the clear reservoir. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. The assembled stand must look completely solid matte black with no transparent parts visible. Use the provided product reference images to maintain product color, shape, and structure.
